race.comment: Plenty of key hopes come out which leaves ANGLING ANGEL (9) on top. She resumes having last been seen running in a G3 SA Fillies Classic over 2500m. She was well backed there and can sprint well fresh in what looks a winnable race. EGYPTIAN THORN (1) ran a sound race first up at Ballarat when midfield with improvement to come. He can roll forward and give a sight. LITTLE RICHO (3) was okay fresh at Mornington and can improve having shown some ability last time in. THE MINSTREL BOY (7) wasn't beaten far on debut at Echuca and should come on from that, each way. GENOMIC (2) struggled fresh but was in the market and can bounce back.
